preimages.meaning: 中文：强制效果 ID 0x1B 的 PPC 直接检查返回真。 / English: Force the direct PPC check for effect ID 0x1B to return true.

anchors.meaning: 中文：调用前把效果 ID 0x1B 放入 PPC 参数 r4。 / English: Loads effect ID 0x1B into PPC argument r4 before the call.

known_risks: 中文：该源项名称写作“会心不显示”，但 ARM 指令实际把两条会心加成路径改为 100；它与 #72 共享 Wii U 路径，二者不可同时启用。 / English: The source label says critical display hidden, but its ARM instructions set two affinity-add paths to 100; it shares Wii U paths with #72 and the two cannot be enabled together.
license: MIT for repository-authored metadata and patch source; no game assets included.
summary: 中文：虽然 3DS 源名称写作“会心不显示”，实际代码会把两条会心加成路径由 30 改为 100，当前行为等同于 #72“会心率 100%”，并不会隐藏会心特效。 状态：Runtime Experimental，默认关闭。 / English: Despite the 3DS source label “Critical Display Hidden,” the code changes two affinity-add paths from 30 to 100; it currently behaves like #72 Affinity 100% and does not hide critical-hit effects. Status: Runtime Experimental; disabled by default.
